candidates.change_summary: Change the condition so winner branch triggers when random == 1 instead of random == 0, altering when pot is reset.
Increase the fee subtracted from pot on win from FEE_AMOUNT to 2 * FEE_AMOUNT, changing the final pot value when a payout occurs.
Remove resetting pot to zero after payout, so pot retains its value after a winning play.
Move the pot increment to occur after the random check and payout, so pot may not increase on winning plays.
On win, set pot to the transferred fee amount instead of zero, altering the post-call pot value.
Change the required ticket payment so play reverts unless msg.value == 11 instead of 10, altering whether pot is updated and thus observable play behavior.
Change pot update to add only the fee amount instead of the full msg.value, altering the pot value after play.
Remove resetting pot to zero in the winning branch so pot remains after a win, changing observable pot value.
Transfer the fee to msg.sender instead of bank in the winning branch, changing resulting balances and pot flow observable after play.
Change the random condition to random == 1 so the winning branch triggers on the opposite outcome, altering observable behavior.
